## PhysicsIntegrationStep_e620_0045e620 — PhysicsIntegrationStep

**Summary:** Performs per-axle physics integration step: computes wheel velocity deltas from vehicle state, samples terrain roughness/height, integrates suspension velocity and displacement with semi-implicit Euler, applies velocity clamping, and stores updated wheel state. Part of vehicle physics simulation.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** UtilityFunction_3d50 (00463d50)

**Guard conditions:** Time step clamp: if dbl_8AFE98 >= 0, clamp to max 0.033333335 (1/30); if < 0, set to 0. Only performs full integration branch if TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling succeeds, v56 > wheel threshold, and penetration limit > 0. Otherwise, falls through to simple position/velocity store path.
